title: 2004 HMMT February Geometry Problem 6
statement: In trapezoid \(A B C D\) shown, \(A D\) is parallel to \(B C\), and \(A B=6, B C=7, C D=\) \(8, A D=17\). If sides \(A B\) and \(C D\) are extended to meet at \(E\), find the resulting angle at \(E\) (in degrees).

solutions.text:
90
Choose point \(F\) on \(A D\) so that \(B C D F\) is a parallelogram. Then \(B F=C D=8\), and \(A F=A D-D F=A D-B C=10\), so \(\triangle A B F\) is a 6-8-10 right triangle. The required angle is equal to \(\angle A B F=90^{\circ}\).
